definitions.ground_truth: Label = (OS from run.environment.os, application from sample.tool_id) as recorded by the generator invocation. Never derived from classifier output.
definitions.included: Catalogue sample with status 'generated', a safe relative path inside data_dir, an existing artifact whose size and SHA-256 match the catalogue. Bytes are read once and the same bytes are hashed and classified.
definitions.top1: Prediction exists only when exactly one candidate holds the maximum score. Ties at the maximum are AMBIGUOUS; empty candidate lists are UNKNOWN; exceptions are ERROR. The first list element is never chosen to break a tie.
definitions.os_prediction: OS predicted when every maximum-score candidate shares one OS (a tool tie within one OS still yields an OS prediction); otherwise AMBIGUOUS/UNKNOWN/ERROR.
definitions.accuracy: correct / denominator, where the denominator counts every in-scope included sample including UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS and ERROR outcomes (all counted as not correct).
definitions.tool_accuracy_scope: Included, in-catalog samples (overall) / with truth OS Windows.
definitions.os_accuracy_scope: Included samples whose truth OS maps to a catalogue OS, in-catalog and out-of-catalog applications alike.
definitions.precision: TP(X) / unique top-1 predictions of X among in-catalog samples. precision_with_out_of_catalog also counts out-of-catalog false attributions to X.
definitions.recall: TP(X) / in-catalog samples whose truth is X.
definitions.candidate_coverage: In-catalog samples whose truth label appears anywhere in candidates.
definitions.unique_sha256: One representative per SHA-256 among included samples. Groups whose members disagree on truth are excluded from unique metrics and reported as conflicts.
definitions.threshold_status: met | not_met | insufficient_coverage | no_data; computed on the unique-SHA-256 set. 'met' additionally requires every catalogue label in scope to have at least one sample.

counts.independence_note: Runs share machine, OS build and tool versions; repeated runs re-measure the same configuration and are not independent evidence. Byte-identical archives are counted once in the unique-SHA-256 metrics.
